15th November – Feeding cows at Panjrapole Gaushala
A Moment of Kindness and Compassion – Feeding the Cows at Panjarapole Gaushala
The Rotary Club of Mumbai South Cuffe Parade organised a heart-warming visit to Panjarapole Gaushala, an initiative spearheaded by Rotarian Tarun Gada and Joint Secretary Rajesh Dubey.
Around 150 cows, including young and pregnant ones, were treated to fresh green grass and laddus.
But the real joy lay in being among these gentle creatures – feeding them by hand, feeling their affectionate licks and experiencing their innocent warmth. It was a beautiful reminder of how deeply connected we are to all living beings, and how much happiness a simple gesture of kindness can bring.
Attended by 10 Rotarians
Project cost Rs 23,000/-
